title: Auralis model package manifest (v2, unified field system)
description: Single source of truth for cross-platform model package contracts. Canonical field names use camelCase (sizeBytes, sha256). v1 manifests (schemaVersion=1, size_bytes) are a migration input only; see convert/manifest_contract.py for the migration rules. The normative validator is convert/manifest_contract.py; this JSON Schema documents the structure.

version.description: Package version. Placeholder values (0.0.0, strings containing 'placeholder'/'todo'/'tbd') are invalid for status=verified.

status.description: draft may lack sizes/hashes/revisions but must never be treated as app-ready. verified requires complete, non-placeholder data and does not bypass runtime file verification or model smoke gates.

revision.description: Full 40-character model repository git commit. Required for verified unless a complete content-pinned archive source is present. Separate from runtime.runtimeRevision.

archive.description: Content-pinned TAR release source. When present, its exact archive hash/size replace the requirement for a model repository commit; file hashes remain mandatory. Only allow-listed regular files are extracted.

stripPrefix.description: Safe relative directory prefix inside the archive, no trailing slash.

transform.description: One audited metadata-only STQ conversion. Source pins the original artifact; files pins the derived runtime artifact. No arbitrary transform commands.

build.description: Data-only provenance for an audited compiled TTS API2 package. Upstream revision must still be pinned, even with a prebuilt archive. Does not contain executable commands.

provenancePath.description: Safe package-relative JSON supportAsset declared in files with its own hash.

backend.description: Execution backend this bundle is built for. Never inferred from file extension at runtime.

runtimeRevision.description: Pinned runtime revision (e.g. llama.cpp commit or ORT version) this bundle was verified against. Required non-null for verified.

notes.description: Documented runtime constraints, e.g. kernel requirements. Facts only; no performance claims.

languages.description: Language identifiers this package actually supports for its modes. Empty allowed only for draft.

verification.description: Per-capability verification state. Values: unverified | bench-verified | device-verified. Only UI-visible claims with device-verified may be shown as supported.

files.description: Every packaged file including ONNX external data. Draft may use an empty list; verified requires a non-empty list with complete sizeBytes/sha256 for every entry.

path.description: Package-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, '..' segments, empty segments, backslashes and drive letters are invalid.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size. Null allowed only for draft. Never reuse the bundle total as a per-file or memory figure.

sha256.description: 64 lowercase hex chars. Empty string is invalid; use null when unknown (draft only). All-zero strings are placeholders and invalid for verified.

externalData.description: Paths of ONNX external-data files belonging to this model file. Every referenced path must exist in files.

roles.description: Logical role -> file path. Every referenced path must exist in files with classification=model. Verified manifests require at least one role.
